name: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited
remarksWeb: 97,95,900 Equity Shares held by Rikhab Investments B.V. are subject to a contractual non-disposal undertaking dated July 30, 2025 (NDU), entered into between Rikhab Investments B.V. and Catalyst Trusteeship Limited. The NDU was executed in connection with the borrowings availed by Rikhab Investments B.V. from BGTF Loans Aggregator LP for financing the acquisition of Equity Shares of the Company.  Pursuant to the NDU, Rikhab Investments B.V. has, inter alia, undertaken not to sell, transfer or otherwise dispose of the aforesaid Equity Shares, except as permitted under the Facility Agreement dated July 30, 2025 entered into among Rikhab Investments B.V., Dheer Jain, BGTF Loans Aggregator LP, GLAS SAS Frankfurt Branch and Global Loan Agency Services GmbH.  In accordance with the terms of the NDU, the hold created over these equity shares in the depository system was released prior to the filing of the Red Herring Prospectus in relation to the IPO of the Company. However, due to a technical limitation in the depository system, the hold could not be re-created, as the equity shares are presently already subject to the statutory post-IPO lock-in requirement under the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018. The hold will be re-created upon the expiry of the applicable statutory lock-in period.
